y-m-17-04.title: Kuparadzanisa ma marble nehukama 3 : 2, huwandu hwose hunofanira kuva hwakadini?
y-m-17-04.topic: Kugoverwa zvichienderana nehukama: kuparadzanisa nehukama nemamiriro ehuwandu hwose
y-m-17-04.goal: Yedza chirevo che 'kana huwandu hwose ndi odd, haungaparadzanisi 3 : 2' nemuenzaniso unopikisa, uye utsvage mamiriro ehuwandu hwose apo unogona kuparadzaniswa nehukama.
y-m-17-04.material: Unoda kuisa ma marble mu Bhokisi 가 ne Bhokisi 나. Hukama hwehuwandu hwema marble mumabhokisi maviri huchava 3 : 2 (matatu kumaviri), ma marble haagoni kuparadzaniswa kuita zvimedu, uye mabhokisi ose maviri anowana 1 marble kana kupfuura. Yuri akati, “Kana huwandu hwose hwema marble ndi odd, haungaparadzanisi 3 : 2. Nhamba ye odd haigoni kuparadzaniswa zvakaenzana!”
y-m-17-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inogutsa mamiriro
y-m-17-04.prereq.0: Zvinoreva hukama 3 : 2 (kana divi rimwe ndi3 mapoka, rimwe divi ndi2 mapoka)
y-m-17-04.s.s1.prompt: Nzira ipi inokodzera zvakanyanya yekutarisa kuti chirevo chaYuri chakarurama here?
y-m-17-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga tarisa kuti chirevo chaYuri chinoti 'nguva dzose' kana chinoti 'mune dzimwe nyaya.'
y-m-17-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tanga ne3 mubhokisi rimwe uye usarudze rimwe bhokisi uchichengeta hukama. Tarisa kuti huwandu hwose ndi odd here kana even.
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.a: Nhamba ye odd haigoni kuparadzaniswa zvakaenzana, saka taura pakarepo kuti chakarurama
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.a: 3 : 2 hakusi kuparadzanisa zvakaenzana. Paradzanisa 'kuparadzanisa zvakaenzana' ne 'kuparadzanisa nehukama.'
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.b: Tsvaga nyaya imwe apo huwandu hwose ndi odd uye hunoparadzana 3 : 2
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.b: Chirevo che 'hachimbondishandi' chinoputswa nenyaya imwe inoshanda. Uri kuedza kutsvaga muenzaniso wakadaro.
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.c: Edza kuparadzanisa ma marble 7 e odd 3 : 2, uye kana isingashande, taura kuti Yuri akarurama
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.c: Kungoti 7 haishande hakureve kuti nhamba dze odd dzimwe hadzishande. Nyaya imwe yakakundikana haigoni kumirira 'nhamba dze odd dzose.'
y-m-17-04.s.s1.o.d: Taura kuti haugoni kuyedza nekuti hauzivi huwandu hwema marble
y-m-17-04.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kugadzirisa huwandu hwema marble uye kuiyedza. Unongofanira kuyedza nhamba dzakawanda.
y-m-17-04.s.s1.explain: Chirevo che 'hapana nhamba ye odd inoshanda' chinoputswa nekungowana nhamba imwe ye odd inoparadzana 3 : 2. Kuwana nhamba dzakawanda dze odd dzisingashande, senge 7, hakusimbisi kuti chirevo chakarurama.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mienzaniso miviri yakasiyana inoratidza kuti chirevo chaYuri hachina kururama. Huwandu hwose ndi huwandu hwe odd hwema marble, 가 : 나 = 3 : 2, uye huwandu hwose ndi100 kana pasi.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.hint.0: Edza ma marble 3 mu Bhokisi 가 ne2 mu Bhokisi 나. Tsvagawo nhamba dzimwe dzine hukama 3 : 2, uye uenzanise kuti huwandu hwose ndi odd kana even.
y-m-17-04.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti huwandu hwose ndi odd kana even kana poka rimwe riri marble 1 nekana riri marble 2, uye usarudze hukuru hwepoka hunopa huwandu hwose hwe odd.

Batanidza pepa risina kupindirana, uye usafunge nezvehupamhi hwemubatanidzwa. Shandisa 3.14 se pi, uye shandisa pepa serectangle sezvariri.

y-m-17-12.title: Tanka rinobata 0.048 L yemvura chete?
y-m-17-12.topic: Kushandura mayuniti evolume: m³, cm³, L
y-m-17-12.goal: Wana kukanganisa mukugadzirisa kwakashandisa hukama hwemayuniti ekureba zvakananga kumayuniti evolume, sarudza nzira yekuongorora kana mugumisiro uine chirevo, uye unyore zvakare zvakarurama.
y-m-17-12.material: Pane tangi rakaita sechimiro chebhokisi rakareba. Rakareba 1.2 m, rakafara 0.8 m, uye rakakwira 0.5 m, uye funga mukati sehukuru hwakafanana. Tangi iri rinogona kubata mvura inoverengeka mu L ingani kana rizere kusvika pamusoro? Subin akagadzirisa sepazasi asi akanzwa kuti mhinduro inoshamisa.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wakanganisa mumhinduro yaSubin. (Nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga ne 1.)
y-m-17-12.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kana kuchinja kureba kwe 1 m kuva 100 cm kwakarurama, uye kana unogona kushandisa 100 nenzira imwe chete kana uchichinja vhoriyumu ye 1 m³.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja divi rekyubhu rine mativi e 1 m kuva cm uye utsvage vhoriyumu yaro zvakananga.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.line.3: 1 L = 1000 cm³, saka 48 cm³ = 0.048 L. Tangi iri rinobata mvura ye 0.048 L.
y-m-17-12.s.s1.explain: Kukanganisa kunotanga pamutsetse 2. 1 m ndi 100 cm, asi vhoriyumu ye 1 m³ ndiyo vhoriyumu yekyubhu ine mativi e 1 m, saka ndi 100 × 100 × 100 = 1000000 cm³. Mitsetse 3 ne 4 yakatakura kushandurwa kwakanganisa uye yakava nokukosha kwakanganisa. Kuverenga pamutsetse 1 kwakarurama.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.prompt: Ndedzipi nzira dzokutarisa dzinokubatsira kucherechedza kuti mhedzisiro yaSubin (0.048 L) inoshamisa? Sarudza dzose dzinokodzera.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa nemashoko hukuru hwetangi nehukuru hwebhokisi rimwe remukaka (1 L).
y-m-17-12.s.s2.hint.1: Gadzirisa nenhevedzano yakasiyana neyaSubin (kuchinja kureba kwose kuva cm kubva pakutanga) uye utarise kuti mhedzisiro mbiri dzakafanana.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.a: Dzvanya kuverenga kumwe chete pakashandisi kuverenga kamwe zvakare kuti uone kana kukosha kwakafanana kunobuda
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.a: Kana ukaverenga nepfungwa imwe chete, kukosha kwakafanana kunobuda zvakare. Kuti kuverenga kwakarurama here uye kuti kushandurwa kwakarurama here zvinhu zvakasiyana.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.b: Enzanisa hukuru hwetangi nehukuru hwebhokisi remukaka re 1 L
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.b: Wakatarisa kana mhedzisiro ichinzwisisika nokuenzanisa nehukuru hwechinhu chaicho.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.c: Bvisa zvikamu uye utonge hukuru nenhamba oga
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.c: Kana chikamu chichichinja, nhamba imwe chete inova hukuru hwakasiyana zvakakwana. Moyo wedambudziko ndewokuti chikamu chakanganisa here.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.o.d: Chinja kureba kwose kuva cm kubva pakutanga, gadzirisazve, uye uenzanise
y-m-17-12.s.s2.r.d: Wakagadzirisazve nenhevedzano yakasiyana uye wakaenzanisa mhedzisiro. Kutarisa kana kukosha kuri kwakafanana pasinei nenhevedzano yokushandura.
y-m-17-12.s.s2.explain: Kana ukarangarira kuti tangi rakakura zvikuru kupfuura bhokisi remukaka, kana ukachinja kuva cm kubva pakutanga uye ukaenzanisa nokuverenga 120 × 80 × 50, unogona kuona kuti 0.048 L inoshamisa. Kudzokorora kuverenga kumwe chete kana kubvisa zvikamu hakuratidzi kukanganisa.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.prompt: Gadzirisa kushandurwa kwakanganisa mumhinduro yaSubin uye utsvage kuti tangi iri rinobata mvura mu L ingani. Nyorawo kuti wakaziva sei.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.hint.0: Sezvo 1 m ari 100 cm, chinja divi rekyubhu rine mativi e 1 m kuva cm uye utsvage vhoriyumu yaro.
y-m-17-12.s.s3.hint.1: Chinja kureba kwose kwekutanga kuva cm, wanza, uye uenzanise kana kwakafanana nekukosha kwawawana.

y-m-17-01.title: Ndinofanira kudhirowa 3 km zvakareba sei pamepu?
y-m-17-01.topic: Sikero: reshiyo yokureba pamepu nokureba chaiko
y-m-17-01.goal: Tsvaga kuti sikero inobatanidza sei kureba pamepu nokureba chaiko kuti utsvage kukanganisa mumhinduro, uye ugadzire mapeya akati wandei (kureba pamepu, sikero) anowirirana nokureba chaiko kumwe chete.
y-m-17-01.material: Unoda kudhirowa nzira yokufamba iri pamberi pechikoro pamepu. Pasi pemepu, sikero '1 : 50000' (kumwe kusvika makumi mashanu ezviuru) yakanyorwa. Izvi zvinoreva kuti 1 cm pamepu ndi 50000 cm muchokwadi, uye mepu yose yakadzikiswa nereshiyo imwe chete. 1 km ndi 100000 cm. Mina akagadzirisa 'Ndinofanira kudhirowa ma cm mangani pamepu enzira iri chaizvo 3 km?' sepazasi.

y-m-17-01.thinking.2: Kugadzira nyaya dzakati wandei dzinosangana nemamiriro
y-m-17-01.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti sikero (se 1 : 50000) ndiyo reshiyo yokureba pamepu nokureba chaiko
y-m-17-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga wakanganisa mumhinduro yaMina.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa mhedzisiro kutanga. Zvakanaka here kuti kureba kwokudhirowa pamepu kuve kurefu zvikuru kupfuura kureba chaiko kwe 300000 cm?

y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.1: 1 cm pamepu ndi 50000 cm muchokwadi, saka (kureba pamepu) = (kureba chaiko) × 50000.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka nzira yokufamba inofanira kudhirowa pamepu se 15000000000 cm.
y-m-17-01.s.s1.explain: Kukanganisa kunotanga pamutsetse 2. Sikero 1 : 50000 inoreva kuti kureba chaiko kuri nguva 50000 kureba pamepu, saka kuti utsvage kureba pamepu unofanira kuparadzanisa kureba chaiko ne 50000, kwete kuwanza ne 50000. Kuverenga pamutsetse 3 kunotevera mutsetse 2 saka kuverenga pachako kwakarurama asi mhedzisiro inoshamisa, uye mutsetse 4 wakanganisa nechikonzero chimwe chete. Kana yaverengwa zvakarurama, inodhirowa se 6 cm pamepu.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.prompt: Ndedzipi nzira dzokutarisa dzinokubatsira kucherechedza kuti mhedzisiro yaMina inoshamisa? Sarudza dzose dzinokodzera.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.0: Pasarudzo yega yega, enzanisa ‘kutarisa uku kungakubatsira kuziva kuti pfungwa yakanganisa, kana kungodzokorora pfungwa imwe chete here?’
y-m-17-01.s.s2.hint.1: Chinja 15000000000 cm yakawanikwa naMina kuva km, uye ufunge kana ichireba kunogona kudhirowa pamepu imwe.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.a: Dzvanya kuverenga kumwe chete pakashandisi kuverenga kamwe zvakare kuti uone kana kukosha kwakafanana nokwekutanga kunobuda
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.a: Kana ukaverenga nepfungwa imwe chete, kukosha kwakafanana kunobuda zvakare. Kuti kuverenga kwakarurama here uye kuti pfungwa (chirevo) yakarurama here zvinhu zvakasiyana.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.b: Nhamba yakakura zvikuru, saka kungonyora chikamu mu km kunoita kuti kukosha kuve kwakarurama
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.b: Kana ukachinja chikamu chete, nhamba yaunonyora inochinja asi kureba kunoramba kuri kwakafanana. 15000000000 cm ndi 150000 km, iri refu zvikuru kudhirowa pamepu.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.c: Nyora nenhevedzano kuti 1 cm, 2 cm, ne 3 cm pamepu ndi ma cm chaiwo mangani
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukanyora zvinoreva sikero nemutsara, unogona kuona kuti nzira ipi yakakura.
y-m-17-01.s.s2.o.d: Shandisa pfungwa yakajairika kubvunza kana kureba kwakadhirowa pamepu kungava kurefu kupfuura kureba chaiko
y-m-17-01.s.s2.r.d: Uri kutarisa kana mhedzisiro ichinzwisisika nepfungwa yeshoko yokuti mepu mufananidzo wakadzikiswa wechokwadi.

y-m-17-01.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, uchifunga zvakarurama, unoda kudhirowa mugwagwa uri chaizvo 2 km se cm pamepu (nhamba yechisikigo kubva pa 4 kusvika pa 20). Gadzira masikero maviri '1 : b' aungashandisa, ane kureba kwakasiyana pamepu.

y-m-17-07.title: Kunyora zvakare ‘kukwira ne 5%’ kwechikoro nyaya
y-m-17-07.goal: Taura kana ‘kukwira ne 5%’ i kuchinja kwe rate kana kuchinja kwehuwandu hwevanhu, uye unyore zvakare mushoko nenhamba kuti vaverengi varege kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-17-07.material: Chikoro nyaya chakadhinda nyaya yakadai. "Chikamu chevadzidzi vanouya kuchikoro nebhasikoro chakakwira ne 5%, kubva ku 25% makore maviri apfuura kusvika ku 30% gore rino." Chikoro chine vadzidzi 200 mumakore ose (huwandu hwevadzidzi hauna kuchinja). Muverengi mumwe akati, "Saka zvinoreva kuti vadzidzi 10 vakawedzera," uye muverengi mumwe akaverenga se, "Inoti yakakwira ne 5%, saka vadzidzi 50 vakava anenge 52 kana 53." (Kana ratio ikakwira kubva ku 25% kusvika ku 30%, tinoti ‘yakakwira ne 5 percentage points.’ Percentage point i shoko remusiyano pakati pema ratio maviri.)
y-m-17-07.thinking.2: Kuenzanisa ma rate anochinja nehuwandu hwekutanga

y-m-17-07.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga zvakaparadzana kana mushoko rekuti ‘5%’ riri nezvehuwandu hwevadzidzi 200 vese kana nezvehuwandu hwekutanga hwevatasvi vemabhasikoro.
y-m-17-07.s.s1.o.a: Vadzidzi vanouya kuchikoro nebhasikoro vakabva pa 50 kusvika pa 52 kana 53
y-m-17-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga 5% ye 50 sekuwedzera. Verenga kuti 30% i vadzidzi vangani chaizvo uye uenzanise.
y-m-17-07.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwevadzidzi vese hwakakura, saka chikamu chevatasvi vemabhasikoro chakakura
y-m-17-07.s.s1.r.b: Data inoti huwandu hwevadzidzi vese hahuna kuchinja.
y-m-17-07.s.s1.o.c: Vadzidzi vanouya kuchikoro nebhasikoro vakawedzera ne 20% yehuwandu hwekutanga
y-m-17-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakaenzanisa kuwedzera kwehuwandu hwevanhu nehuwandu hwekutanga. Wakaverenga uchitora huwandu hwevanhu sehwekutanga.

y-m-17-07.s.s1.explain: 25% i 50 pa 200 vadzidzi uye 30% i 60 pa 200 vadzidzi. Rate yakakwira 5 percentage points, kubva ku 25% kusvika ku 30%, uye huwandu hwevanhu hwakabva pa 50 kusvika pa 60, kuwedzera kwe 10, ndiko kuti, 20% yehwekutanga. ‘Kukwira ne 5%’ kwenyaya kunogona kuverengwa sekureva kuti rate yakakwira, asi vamwe vaverengi vanoverenga sehuwandu hwevanhu hwakakwira ne 5%.

y-m-17-08.title: Kureba kwakarukutwa nevhiri: zvakanaka here kufungidzira pi se 3?
y-m-17-08.goal: Shandisa zviitiko zvaunogadzira iwe pachako kutarisa kuti circumference inochinja zvakadini nefungidziro ye pi (3, 3.14), uye utsanangure kuti kuti zvakanaka kushandisa fungidziro kunoenderana nekurongeka kunodiwa nehuwandu hwekurukutwa.
y-m-17-08.material: Unorukutisa chishandiso chekuyera chakaita sevhiri chine diameter ye d cm pasi kuyera kureba. Vhiri harityoki, uye kana rarukuta kamwe rinofamba kureba kwakaenzana necircumference yevhiri. Vamwe vanofungidzira pi se 3 uye vamwe vanoverenga ne 3.14. y-m-17-08.s.s1.hint.0: Wana kureba kunorukutwa nevhiri rine diameter ye 50 cm kamwe uchishandisa pi se 3 ne 3.14, uye uenzanise musiyano.

y-m-17-08.s.s1.r.a: 3.14 i fungidziro ye pi zvakare. Kana uchishandisa fungidziro, chekutanga i ‘kuti inofanira kunge yakarurama zvakadini.’
y-m-17-08.s.s1.o.b: Pi iri padyo ne 3, saka kuverenga ne 3 kunogara kwakakwana
y-m-17-08.s.s1.r.b: Musiyano mudiki pakurukuta vhiri kamwe chete unogona kukura painonyanya kurukutwa.
y-m-17-08.s.s1.o.c: Kuverenga ne 3 kwakanaka kune kutenderera kamwe chete, uye kubva pakutenderera ka2 hazvina
y-m-17-08.s.s1.r.c: Zvakarurama kuti musiyano unoungana, asi hakuna muganhu sa ‘kubva pakutenderera ka2, kwete.’ Zvinoenderana nekurongeka kunodiwa.
y-m-17-08.s.s1.o.d: Zvinoenderana nekukanganisa kunobvumidzwa uye huwandu hwekutenderera hwakarukutwa
y-m-17-08.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i pfungwa yekuti unofanira kufunga nezvekukanganisa kunobvumidzwa nehuwandu hwekurukuta pamwe chete.
y-m-17-08.s.s1.explain: Kunyange kana musiyano wekutenderera kamwe uri mudiki, kana ukarukutisa vhiri kakawanda musiyano unoungana ukakura. Unofanira kusarudza fungidziro zvichienderana nekuti unoda pfungwa yakazara kana kuyera chaiko.
y-m-17-08.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira zviitiko zviviri zvakasiyana apo musiyano pakati pekureba kwakaverengwa ne pi se 3 nekureba kwakaverengwa ne 3.14 i 100 cm (1 m) kana kupfuura.

y-m-17-10.title: Ndakaisa ibwe uye mvura yakakwira
y-m-17-10.topic: Volume yerectangular prism nechinhu chiri pasi pemvura
y-m-17-10.goal: Edza, neruzivo rutsva, pfungwa yekuwana volume yechinhu kubva pashanduko yehurefu hwemvura mutanka yerectangular-prism, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana mamiriro ekuti chinhu chiri pasi pemvura zvachose asingashande.
y-m-17-10.material: Pane tanka rakaita serectangular prism. Mukati mayo i30 cm upamhi, 20 cm kureba, uye 20 cm hurefu, uye rine mvura kusvika pahurefu hwe10 cm. Kana ibwe rikaiswa mumvura, mvura inokwira nehuwandu hwakaenzana nezvinosundwa neibwe. Ibwe harinwi mvura, uye kukora kwemadziro etanka hakuverengwi.
y-m-17-10.thinking.1: Kuwana mamiriro umo nzira yekuwana volume inoshanda
y-m-17-10.prereq.1: Kuti chikamu chinobata mvura chinogonawo kuonekwa serectangular prism
y-m-17-10.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe apo ruzivo rutsva runobuda, sarudza kufunga kwako, uye utarise kuti kufunga kwako kunochinja sei pamberi nepashure peruzivo.
y-m-17-10.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho yega yega, tanga wawana kuti mvura yakakwira macm mangani uye volume yechikamu chakakwira.
y-m-17-10.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kana kufunga kwako kwenhanho yapfuura kuchienderana neruzivo rutsva, uye kana chimwe chikamu chisingaenderani, wana zvawakafungidzira.
y-m-17-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana ibwe rimwe rakaiswa kuti riri pasi pemvura zvachose, mvura yakava 12 cm. Mvura haina kupfachukira.

y-m-17-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Iyi pfungwa yakangwarira yakafungawo nezvekugoneka kwekuti mabwe angatakurana abude mumvura.
